For information only — not financial advice. Royalty statements follow your contract's exact price basis and deductions.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter units sold and the per-unit price (or wholesale price).
  2. Enter your royalty rate percentage.
  3. Enter any advance already paid to you.
  4. Read royalty earned, how much of the advance is recouped, the amount payable now, and any unrecouped balance.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is advance recoupment?

An advance is a prepayment against future royalties. You only receive new payments once earned royalties exceed the advance; the rest is the unrecouped balance.

Is the royalty on gross or net revenue?

This tool computes on the gross revenue you enter (units times price). Many contracts use net receipts or wholesale price instead, so use the price basis your contract defines.

What if royalties never exceed the advance?

Then nothing further is payable, and the unrecouped balance usually does not have to be repaid unless your contract says otherwise.
